meta.name: coding-agent-sessions
meta.description: MUST USE when asked to find, read, list, search, inspect, fetch, export, or reconstruct coding-agent sessions across Codex, Claude Code/Desktop, OpenCode, OMO/Senpi/pi, oh-my-pi (omp), gajae-code (gjc), OpenClaw, Factory Droid, Amp, Gemini/Kimi/Qwen CLIs, Codebuff, Roo/Kilo/Cline, Kodu, Cursor CLI, Aider, Aside browser-agent sessions, or unknown local agent logs. Covers transcripts, session IDs, rollout JSONL, state SQLite, Claude projects/pre-compact histories, OpenCode messages/parts, child/subagent linkage, cwd/model/time/token filters, archives, and cost clues. Expands fuzzy recall into parallel query lanes and first probes known stores so absent platforms are skipped cheaply. Triggers: coding agent sessions, Codex/Claude/OpenCode/OMO/Senpi/pi/oh-my-pi/omp/gajae-code/gjc/OpenClaw/Droid/Amp/Kodu/Cursor/Aider/Aside sessions, transcript search, session history, session ID, read transcript, token usage, subagent sessions, what did I do yesterday, did we already do this.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搜索并重建多款编码工具的历史会话
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你常用多个编码助手且记不清当时是怎么实现的
copy.tagline_en: Find and reconstruct past coding agent sessions across many tools
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you juggle multiple coding agents and often lose track of what happened.

howto.what: 装上后，当 Claude 需要回答与编程代理历史会话相关的问题时，会先去本地磁盘查找 Codex、Claude Code、OpenCode 等工具的会话记录，读取其中的对话、时间、模型等信息，再据此回答，而不是只凭记忆。也支持用多个关键词并行搜索模糊记忆。
howto.when: 当用户要求查找、搜索或读取某个编程代理的会话，或问“前几天做了什么”等回顾性问题时触发。

say.text: 帮我找找昨天 Codex 里部署相关的会话
say.note: 会搜索 Codex 记录并显示匹配会话

say.text: 我们之前是不是给 opencode 修过那个 bug？
say.note: 会用多个关键词并行搜索，返回候选会话

say.text: 列出这周所有 Claude Code 的会话记录
say.note: 会列出该平台会话并显示摘要

howto.what_en: Once enabled, Claude finds local coding-agent sessions (Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, etc.) before answering memory questions, reading transcripts, IDs, timestamps, and models. Vague recall becomes parallel query lanes with matched sessions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to find, list, search, or read a coding-agent session, or asks recall questions like 'what did I do yesterday' or 'did we already do this'.

say_en.text: Find my Codex session about deployment from yesterday.
say_en.note: Searches Codex logs and shows matching sessions.

say_en.text: Did we already fix that opencode bug before?
say_en.note: Runs parallel keyword search and returns candidates.

say_en.text: List all Claude Code sessions from this week.
